The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the factory_reset function in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.8 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is exploitable via a two-step chain: an unauthenticated attacker first stores an arbitrary ticket_attachment_path value by submitting a ticket through the nopriv eh_crm_new_ticket_post AJAX endpoint (whose nonce is publicly exposed via the [wsdesk_support] shortcode), then triggers the factory_reset routine via a GET request to wp-admin/admin.php?page=wsdesk_factory_reset, which is guarded only by is_admin() — a request-type check — rather than a capability check, causing unlink() to be called on the attacker-supplied path.
products: ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System

description: An Improper Export of Android Application Components vulnerability in ASUS Router App allows a third-party application on the same device to send a crafted Intent that causes ASUS Router App to open an specified URL. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Android App ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

Ghost is a Node.js content management system. From 6.56.0 until 6.67.0, an image processing library bundled with Ghost contained a vulnerability in its SVG handling. Any staff user, including Contributors, could create a bookmark card for an attacker-controlled website, resulting in arbitrary commands being run on the Ghost server. This issue is fixed in version 6.67.0.

Use-after-free via repopulation of last_fatal_error_backtrace global after shutdown. A fatal error raised while modified INI settings are restored during request shutdown can repopulate the stored fatal error backtrace after the executor has been cleaned up. The request memory is then freed, and a diagnostic emitted before executor initialization in a later request handled by the same PHP-FPM or mod_php worker can access the stale backtrace. The shutdown error requires per-path configuration of max_memory_limit, or of zlib.output_compression together with output_handler (which .user.ini can also set). The early diagnostic requires Apache per-directory configuration or, for PHP-FPM, a PHP_VALUE or PHP_ADMIN_VALUE parameter sent by the front end. This can cause memory corruption and worker crashes, and may allow remote code execution. This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Insufficient validation of untrusted input in Enterprise Reporting in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. This affects the function FUN_0040efb0 of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Subscription Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument service results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Altium Workflow Engine due to missing server-side input sanitization in workflow form submission APIs. A regular authenticated user can inject arbitrary JavaScript into workflow data. When an administrator views the affected workflow, the injected payload executes in the administrator’s browser context, allowing privilege escalation, including creation of new administrator accounts, session token theft, and execution of administrative actions.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.9.4 to 3.10.3, NLTK ZIP package extraction can write through an existing in-root hardlink whose other link points outside the NLTK data root. A local attacker who can prepare the extraction target can cause a package member write to overwrite an out-of-root file, violating the pathsec containment boundary and affecting integrity and availability. This issues is fixed in version 3.10.4.

BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v2/workflow/invoke and /api/v2/workflow/stop routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to run workflows as the administrator. Attackers knowing a workflow UUID can supply an override replacing a Code node's code parameter with Python passed to exec(), achieving remote code execution, or stop other users' workflow sessions.

Missing authorization in the JSON-RPC web services interface of Extreme Networks Switch Engine (EXOS) allows an authenticated, low-privileged (read-only) user to execute CLI show commands that are restricted to that role through the command line interface. Successful exploitation results in disclosure of sensitive information, including the device configuration and the password hashes of local accounts. Configuration, enable, and debug commands are not affected. Disclosed password hashes can be attacked offline, and a weak password could lead to administrative access to the device. This issue is fixed in Switch Engine 33.7.1-patch1-11, 33.1.100.133-patch1-9, and 32.7.4.15-patch1-11. Extreme Networks would like to thank Toàn Lê (GitHub: https://github.com/toanln-cov) for responsibly disclosing this vulnerability and for working with our PSIRT team through coordinated disclosure.

When the rsyslog's `imuxsock` is parsing the TAG field from a message with a accepted shorter timestamp, the cursor used to read the message fields and the remaining message length to be read are left in a inconsistent state in relation to the content in the raw message, leading the module to read one byte past the end of the buffer holding the message.

open 7.2.0 before 11.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code by supplying crafted URLs on Windows and WSL. Attackers can embed $(...) subexpressions in URLs, such as OAuth authorization_endpoint values from malicious MCP servers, which execute when index.js passes them unescaped to powershell -EncodedCommand.

The SimpleForm – Form Maker to Chat Apps with Quiz, Poll and Multi Lead Notifications plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 3.10.0 This is due to the `wp_ajax_nopriv_simpleform_wp_register` AJAX action lacking any capability check for role assignment and the `save_custom_fields_to_user_meta()` function using an exclusion list that omits `wp_capabilities`, combined with `get_form_settings()` returning a hard-coded defaults array that unconditionally enables meta writing regardless of the supplied `form_id`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create a new Administrator-level WordPress account by supplying `wp_capabilities[administrator]=1` alongside standard registration fields. The nonce required by the endpoint is publicly emitted into the `front_end_data` JavaScript object on every front-end page via `wp_enqueue_scripts`, making it trivially obtainable by any unauthenticated visitor before submitting the malicious request.
products: SimpleForm – Form Maker to Chat Apps with Quiz, Poll and Multi Lead Notifications

description: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone-linking page can disclose campaign and banner names and identifiers belonging to another agency. An authenticated manager, or a website user with permission to link banners to zones, can supply another agency's advertiser and campaign identifiers because the selection lists are not restricted to the agency owning the zone.

The URL Shortify plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Open Redirect in all versions up to, and including, 1.12.1 due to insufficient validation on the 'redirect_to' parameter in the promotional dismissal handler. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to potentially malicious sites via a crafted link.
products: URL Shortify – Simple and Easy URL Shortener

description: ABP Framework 2.9.0 before 10.6.2 and 10.7.0 pre-releases before 10.7.0 contain a path traversal vulnerability in DefaultBlobFilePathCalculator that allows unauthenticated attackers to access files outside the blob container. Attackers can send %5C-encoded backslashes through the Blogging api/blogging/files/{name} endpoint on Windows hosts to read files like appsettings.json containing signing keys and connection strings.

A vulnerability in NLTK versions up to and including 3.9.2 allows arbitrary file read via path traversal in multiple CorpusReader classes, including WordListCorpusReader, TaggedCorpusReader, and BracketParseCorpusReader. These classes fail to properly sanitize or validate file paths, enabling attackers to traverse directories and access sensitive files on the server. This issue is particularly critical in scenarios where user-controlled file inputs are processed, such as in machine learning APIs, chatbots, or NLP pipelines. Exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, including system files, SSH private keys, and API tokens, and may potentially escalate to remote code execution when combined with other vulnerabilities.

In createSessionInternal of PackageInstallerService.java, there is a possible way for an app to update its ownership due to a missing permission check. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

Ghidra before 12.2 contains a numeric truncation vulnerability in PackedDecode::skipAttribute and skipAttributeRemaining in marshal.cc that stores 64-bit string lengths in 32-bit variables. Attackers can supply a crafted packed stream, such as a malicious .sla file, to inject attributes into the decompiler's input or crash the decompiler process.
SCTP protocol dissector heap disclosure in 4.6.0 to 4.6.9 and 4.4.0 to 4.4.19 might enable denial of service or code execution

An unauthenticated SQL injection can occur on the front end of any site that uses craft.search to perform a search, allowing stacked query execution and enabling escalation to an administrator. Note that this only affects MySQL/MariaDB. Impact * SQL injection — The attribute parameter is concatenated into the query unsanitized, and because PDO runs with emulated prepares, stacked statements execute. This gives unauthenticated read and write access to the application database. * Privilege escalation to administrator — The write primitive was used to set the admin flag on user ID 1 in the users table, confirmed by reading the value back. Craft short-circuits its permission checks on this single column, so no further changes were needed. The same primitive can overwrite any account’s password hash. Update to the patched versions (4.18.9 and 5.11.2) to get the fix. If you cannot update immediately, you can block front-end requests with %5Battribute%5D and [attribute] anywhere in the query string as a temporary mitigation.

Insufficient input validation leading to memory overread in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway if the TCP TimeStamp is enabled in TCP Profile and is associated with the virtual server (of type LB, CS, VPN) or the service configured on NetScaler

Topluyo is a social networking platform. A vulnerability exists in Topluyo Desktop for Linux prior to version 2026.9.2410 where user-controlled URLs are unsafely processed, leading to OS Command Injection via the `openExternalLinks()` routine in `utils.js`. An attacker who controls a target URL can execute arbitrary operating system commands with the privileges of the user running the application upon opening the link. Version 2026.9.2410 patches the issue.

GFI HelpDesk before 4.99.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the archiver export feature that allows authenticated attackers with administrator privileges to execute arbitrary SQL queries by supplying crafted itemid[] array values to /admin/index.php?/archiver/Manager/ExportAll. The Controller_Manager.ExportAll() method joins the itemid values with implode() and GetWhere() concatenates them into an IN() clause without sanitization or parameterization, and DumpTables() executes the resulting query against each ticket-related table, allowing attackers to read or modify database contents.

Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Nextcloud.get_file that allows authenticated recipe editors to write and delete files by using unsanitized recipe names in temporary paths. Attackers can set a recipe name containing ../ segments via PATCH /api/recipe/ / and request /api/get_recipe_file/ / to overwrite and remove .pdf files outside the temporary directory.

tiny-secp256k1 is a tiny secp256k1 native/JS wrapper. From 2.1.0 until 2.2.5 for tiny-secp256k1 and from 2.2.2 until 2.2.5 for @bitcoin-js/tiny-secp256k1-asmjs, the three-argument xOnlyPointAddTweakCheck path ignores the backend failure return from xOnlyPointAddTweak when a tweak produces the point at infinity. The shared X_ONLY_PUBLIC_KEY_INPUT buffer then still contains the original point, so a caller-controlled resultToCheck equal to that point can make the stale-buffer comparison return true even though no tweaked key exists. Protocols that rely on this helper to validate caller-controlled internal keys, tweaks, and comparison values can accept an invalid derived key. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.5.

A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing data export permission check in administrative form export in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.5, 6.0.0-6.2.2 - The administrative form export did not check the data export permission when copying form data, allowing backend users without this permission to export submitted form data.

A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

The Frontend File Manager Plugin WordPress plugin through 23.6 does not validate a file path derived from user input before deleting the referenced file, allowing unauthenticated users to delete arbitrary files on the server (such as wp-config.php) when guest upload mode is enabled. Deleting wp-config.php forces the site into its setup routine, which can be leveraged toward a full site takeover.

simple-git before 4.1.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the allowUnsafePack guard by supplying the --exec option to non-push git operations. Attackers who influence arguments passed to listRemote() or raw() can inject --exec for ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack to execute commands on the host.
OpenVPN 2.4.0 through 2.6.23 and 2.7_alpha1 through 2.7.8 on Windows allows local authenticated users to execute arbitrary code via a privileged service using user-controlled environment variables.

In ConvertX before 0.19.0, converters/calibre.ts does not block recipe files, and instead passes them to the ebook-convert program from Calibre. This affects executable code in a .recipe or .downloaded_recipe file.

EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit a4161a9, contains a weak password recovery mechanism that allows attackers who obtain a still-valid password-reset link to take over accounts that use a local EUSurvey password. The /auth/reset/ flow checks only the age of a reset code and does not invalidate it after the password is changed, and issuing a newer link leaves earlier links active, so a used or superseded link remains valid for up to 24 hours from issuance and can be reused to set a new password, sign in as the affected user, and lock that user out.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - SQL injection via form IDs in administrative form export in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.5, 6.0.0-6.2.2 - Form IDs passed to the administrative form export were not cast to integers before being added to SQL queries, allowing SQL injection by backend users.
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Drupal Mollie for Drupal allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Mollie for Drupal versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.3.2.

Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Unrestricted File Upload in the /panel/controllers/save_photo.php endpoint. Due to a client-controlled permission check parameter and insufficient validation of the currentpath parameter, an unauthenticated attacker can upload arbitrary files to any locations on the server, leading to Remote Code Execution. This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Inventory System 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file /users.php of the component User Management Page. The manipulation of the argument fullname/username leads to cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

Flowintel's template repository subsystem did not adequately constrain file access to the configured repository base directory. Two related weaknesses existed: - Repository registration and editing accepted arbitrary local paths without verifying they resolved inside the configured REPOSITORY_BASE_PATH, allowing an authenticated user to point a repository at any readable directory on the host. - Manifest and template file lookups used normalized (non-canonical) path joins and a startswith-based guard that could be bypassed by symbolic links, permitting reads of files outside the intended repository. An authenticated user with the ability to add or edit a template repository could therefore cause the application to read and return the contents of arbitrary files readable by the service account, including configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data. Affected: Flowintel versions prior to 4.1.0.

SQL injection via identifier injection in the tableName and tableFields POST parameters of admin AJAX endpoints (admin/AJAX_lookup_handler.php, admin/AJAX_check_id.php, admin/AJAX_vocabolary_control.php) in SENAYAN Library Management System (SLiMS) Bulian 9.8.0 allows any authenticated staff user to extract arbitrary database contents.
Use after free in Chromoting in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via malicious network traffic. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents.

Gogs before 0.14.4 on Windows contains a path equivalence vulnerability in isRepositoryGitPath that allows authenticated users with write access to bypass .git directory protection using NTFS aliases. Attackers can create, rename or upload files via aliases like git~1 or .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION to overwrite .git/config or hooks and execute commands as the Gogs process.

Vim 9.2.0405 before 9.2.1352 contains a security bypass vulnerability in expand_tag_fname() that allows attackers to evade 'tagsecure' URL checks by escaping URLs in tags file entries. Attackers can supply a crafted tags file in a cloned repository so that jumping to a tag makes netrw fetch an attacker-controlled URL leaking environment variable values.

An improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability in the OAuth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.1.1-42962-10, 7.2.1-69057-14, 7.2.2-72806-11, 7.3.2-86009-6, and 7.4.1-90080-2 allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Unlimited Elements Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) unlimited-elements-for-elementor allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates): from n/a through 2.0.20.
products: Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates)

description: A stack-based buffer overflow in an unauthenticated CGI handler of the Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controller allows remote attackers to send specially crafted HTTP/S POST requests, leading to memory corruption, webserver restart and hypothetically potential arbitrary code execution with webserver privileges. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Broadcom has evaluated the severity of this issue to be in the Critical severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 9.8. Affected versions: VMware vCenter Server 9.1.x.x: fixed in 9.1.2 VMware vCenter Server 9.0.x.x: fixed in 9.0.2.0300 VMware vCenter Server 8.0: fixed in 8.0 U3m VMware Cloud Foundation 5.x: fixed in 5.2.5 VMware Telco Cloud Platform 3.0: fixed in KB463501 VMware Telco Cloud Platform 4.x: fixed in KB463501 VMware Telco Cloud Platform 5.0.x: fixed in KB463501 VMware Telco Cloud Platform 5.1.x: fixed in KB463501 VMware Telco Cloud Platform 5.2: fixed in KB463501 VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0: fixed in KB463501

A race condition was addressed with improved locking. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or corrupt kernel memory.

Consul-k8s versions 0.42.0 and later are vulnerable to a cross-namespace authorization bypass in component ACL binding rules that may allow an attacker to obtain elevated Consul privileges. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-110720) is fixed in consul-k8s 2.1.0 and 1.8.18.

Logic vulnerability in TP-Link Archer C20 v5, 6.0, Archer AX53 v1.0 and TL-WR841N v13 (TDDP module) allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute administrative commands including factory reset and device reboot without credentials. Attackers on the adjacent network can remotely trigger factory resets and reboots without credentials, causing configuration loss and interruption of device availability. This issue affects Archer C20 v6.0 < V6_251031, Archer C20 v5
products: Archer C20 v6.0, Archer AX53 v1.0

description: A vulnerability was identified in ООО НПО Ритм GEOritm up to 2.45.1. This affects an unknown part of the file /restapi/objects/obj-groups of the component REST API. Such manipulation of the argument objectId leads to missing authentication. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 2.46 is able to mitigate this issue. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor confirms: "In August 2026, NPO Ritm received an official vulnerability notification from the Russian Federal Service for Technical and Export Control (FSTEC Russia). The vulnerability was registered under identifier BDU:2026-11235. Following our internal investigation, we confirmed the vulnerability and implemented the necessary security fixes. The vulnerability has been fixed on our hosted GEO.RITM server at geo.ritm.ru. The fix has also been included in GEO.RITM version 2.46, which is already being distributed to our customers."

In multiple locations, there is a possible way to execute code in the launcher process due to an over-privileged shell user. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

A user with permission to edit contact points but not their protected fields can change protected settings, such as a contact point's destination URL, by switching an integration to a legacy schema version, which can expose stored credentials and redirect alert notifications (incorrect authorization).

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager with access to two advertisers can associate a conversion tracker owned by one advertiser with a campaign owned by the other. The tracker-campaign page checks access to each object but does not verify that their actual owners match. The resulting association can expose the first advertiser's tracker name and identifier in the second advertiser's restricted conversion report.

U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows an unauthenticated user to inject unauthorized SQL commands that allow the attacker to gain root access and complete control over the database. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

Goproxy before 1.9.4 contains a weak key generation vulnerability in NewCounterEncryptorRandFromKey that derives RSA and Ed25519 leaf certificate private keys from public data due to misuse of hash.Sum. Attackers with the CA certificate and one observed leaf certificate can regenerate that host's leaf private key and impersonate the host to clients trusting the proxy CA.

Tinypool is a minimal Node.js worker thread pool implementation. Prior to 2.1.2, Tinypool reads filename from a caller-supplied options object in pool.run(task, options) without requiring an own property, so a polluted Object.prototype.filename can replace the intended worker module. Applications are affected only when they pass their own second-argument options object to pool.run(); calls without that argument use the trusted default options object. An attacker who can first pollute the prototype can cause the worker pool to load attacker-selected JavaScript and can read or modify task data with the host process's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.2.

Coraza before 3.8.1 extracts multipart upload filenames with Go's mime.ParseMediaType, which silently ignores RFC 5987 filename* parameters whose charset is not utf-8 or us-ascii. Unauthenticated attackers can send a decoy filename with filename*=iso-8859-1''shell.php, or filename* alone, so FILES-based rules never see the real name, letting dangerous uploads reach backends that honor filename*.

In EPICS Base release 7.0.10 and prior, an integer overflow in network request processing can cause memory to be allocated with an incorrect size. Subsequent handling of attacker supplied data may result in memory corruption, denial of service, or potential remote code execution.
Path traversal in image-downloader 4.3.0 allows an attacker who can control the download URL to cause downloaded response data to be written outside the configured destination directory.

SmarterTools SmarterMail File Edit API Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SmarterTools SmarterMail. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileStorageController class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-30742.
Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability in Drupal Real Name allows Code Injection. This issue affects Real Name versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.1.

Seroval facilitates JavaScript value stringification, including complex structures beyond JSON.stringify capabilities. Prior to 1.6.8, fromJSON rebuilds an AsyncIteratorFactoryInstance by calling source.on(listener) without requiring source to be a genuine internal stream. With untrusted Seroval input and an application plugin that returns a callable value or an object exposing an on method, a crafted node can reuse an identifier so the deserializer invokes the plugin-produced value. This is an incomplete-fix variant of CVE-2026-59940. The resulting confidentiality, integrity, or availability impact depends on the behavior exposed by the application plugin. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.8.

Local privilege escalation vulnerability in Iperius Backup 8.8.3, due to insufficient separation between the graphical user interface running with elevated privileges and local users with low privileges. When the backup service is configured to run persistently with Administrator privileges, a local attacker with low privileges can use the native Windows dialogues exposed by the application to run programmes that inherit its elevated context. This allows commands to be executed with SYSTEM or Administrator privileges, depending on the application’s context, and compromises the affected Windows system.

PyJWT is a Python implementation of JSON Web Token standards. Prior to 2.14.0, is_pem_format in jwt/utils.py is affected because is_pem_format does not recognize every PEM representation accepted by the cryptography loader. This occurs when an application mixes HMAC and asymmetric algorithms and supplies a mutated public-key PEM as raw key bytes. As a result, HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key treats the unrecognized asymmetric public key as an HMAC secret. Consequently, an attacker who knows the public key can forge authenticated HMAC tokens. This issue is fixed in version 2.14.0.
IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to missing authorization.

LibRaw 0.22.0 through 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in HuffTable::len() because parse_dht() stores Huffman DC symbols without validating them as difference categories. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF/ARW file with oversized Huffman symbols in a Sony YCbCr lossless JPEG stream to crash applications decoding it, causing denial of service.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, AutoPilot prices block calls using model-supplied input but executes them with the server-resolved credential. Supplying a syntactically valid placeholder credential causes the price rule to evaluate to zero, skipping both the balance check and debit while still running paid blocks on the operator's credential. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

Post-authentication Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability has been identified in the SMA1000 Appliance Management Console (AMC) which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to store and potentially execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the Appliance Management Console (AMC).

VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in the ait.core.server telemetry and command broker (ait-server) in NASA-AMMOS AIT-Core through 3.1.1 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to the ZeroMQ message bus to inject spacecraft command data, exfiltrate command and telemetry traffic, inject forged telemetry, or disrupt the command and telemetry bus. The ait-server ZeroMQ broker binds its XSUB and XPUB sockets to all network interfaces by default without authentication or transport security. An attacker able to reach TCP port 5559 can publish messages onto internal topics, including the __commands__ command topic. With the shipped default configuration, command messages are forwarded through command_stream and emitted on the command-uplink UDP path. An attacker able to reach TCP port 5560 can subscribe to command and telemetry traffic on the ground bus. AIT-Core 3.1.2 changes the default ZeroMQ bind addresses to loopback.

A flaw has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected is the function StrUtil.format of the component Database Backup Module. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port/username/password/dbName can lead to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the web management interface of the Digi PortServer TS, Digi One SP, Digi One SP IA, and Digi One IA allows a remote, authenticated administrator to inject script into certain system configuration fields. The script subsequently executes in the browser of a user who views the affected pages (CWE-79).

In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), several SECURITY DEFINER functions in the pem schema of the PEM backend database are owned by a superuser but do not set a safe search_path. Any PEM user who can connect to the PEM backend database can create objects that these functions use in place of the intended ones, and so run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges. Temporary objects can be used for this on every supported PostgreSQL version, and objects in the public schema on PostgreSQL 14 backends and backends upgraded from PostgreSQL 14. From PEM 10.6.1, these functions run with a fixed search_path.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation Mediawiki - ExternalData Extension allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects Mediawiki - ExternalData Extension: from * before 3.7.

An invalidly formatted IKEv2 fragment causes the Libreswan pluto daemon to crash and restart. Continued exploitation would cause a denial of service. The function reassemble_v2_incoming_fragments() would ignore unknown outer payloads but still store these in a fixed size array msg_digest.digest[PAYLIMIT]. An off-by-one error in the assertion PASSERT(logger, md->digest_roof < elemsof(md->digest)) causes the daemon to abort. No remote code execution is possible. Any configuration that allows IKEv2 connections that do not set fragmentation=no are vulnerable. IKEv1 is not affected.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated.

Langflow eval_custom_component_code Eval Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Langflow. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of eval_custom_component_code function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute python code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-26972.

A vulnerability was determined in humhub lets-meet up to 1.2.1. Affected by this vulnerability is the function NewInviteNotification::html of the file notifications/NewInviteNotification.php of the component Notification Rendering. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 1.2.2 addresses this issue. This patch is called 6c82534ffcb90e74229671a76caef1a8285c5190. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

A origin validation error vulnerability in Fortinet FortiClientMac 7.4.0 through 7.4.7, FortiClientWindows 7.4.0 through 7.4.7, FortiClientWindows 7.2.0 through 7.2.14, FortiClientWindowsPAM 7.4.7, FortiClientWindowsPAM 7.2.14 may allow an unauthorized remote attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands. Successful exploitation requires interaction with the victim.

Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadAction() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c, which never bounds-checks the index into the 1024-entry conditions array. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated .plus game file with unterminated action conditions to write file-controlled values past the array and crash the player.
Untrusted search path in Microsoft Windows App Store allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.6 to 3.10.3, XMLCorpusView._read_xml_fragment accumulates 1 KiB blocks and repeatedly applies whole-buffer XML validation while a comment or CDATA terminator remains ahead. A large comment in an attacker-controlled corpus file causes quadratic CPU consumption through documented XML corpus readers across the affected range. On 3.6 and 3.9.2, a large CDATA section incurs the quadratic scan before rejection, while on 3.10.3 both comment and CDATA documents are read successfully. This vulnerability is fixed in 3.10.4.

Floci 1.1.0 before 2.2.0 contains a code injection vulnerability in VtlTemplateEngine that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands via unrestricted Velocity mapping templates. Attackers can create a REST API with a MOCK integration whose template uses $util reflection to reach Runtime or ProcessBuilder, executing OS commands in the Floci JVM.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Forum Access allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Forum Access versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.3.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce sermepa allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Commerce sermepa versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.5.0.
Server-side request forgery in Profile Data Roaming Service (PDRS) allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Drupal Content Synchronizer allows Object Injection. This issue affects Content Synchronizer versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.1.

Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in WP Media WP Rocket wp-rocket allows Path Traversal.This issue affects WP Rocket: from n/a before 3.24.2.
Buffer overflow in Skia in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.78 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Shorewall and Shorewall6 modules' list.cgi, which renders table fields and COMMENT lines unescaped. Authenticated users with table edit permission can store JavaScript via savecmt.cgi or table entries that executes when other users, including root, view the list page.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the public conversion-variable endpoint does not verify that a caller-supplied conversion belongs to the supplied tracker. An unauthenticated attacker can submit a unique variable for a different tracker's conversion, causing that conversion to be classified as a duplicate and excluded from conversion reports.

The Divi Ajax Filter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 5.1.2 via the 'custom_loop_template' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the loop_templates parameter is set to 'custom-template'.

A flaw has been found in Opixido OCMS up to b7c15660aba83d96677c1a9abaa69c082a24f21c. This impacts an unknown function of the file admin/TUI/index.php of the component Admin TUI. This manipulation of the argument img causes cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Improper certificate validation in the HTTPS listener in Canonical LXD 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8, 6.9 before 4.0.15, 5.0.11, 5.21.9, 6.10.1 allows an unauthenticated attacker to authenticate as any trusted client and gain full access to the cluster and managed virtual machines via a crafted certificate chain.

The Confection WordPress Cable WordPress plugin from 0.4.0 to 0.4.7 does not perform any capability or nonce checks before saving its settings and writing one of them, unmodified, into a standalone PHP file that it then serves, allowing unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Download Count allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Download Count versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.2.5, from 3.0.0 to 3.0.2.

SpeechBrain before 1.1.1 contains an arbitrary code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by supplying a crafted CKPT.yaml checkpoint metadata file parsed with PyYAML's unsafe loader during candidate enumeration in Checkpointer.recover_if_possible(). Attackers can embed malicious Python object construction tags such as !!python/object/apply in any CKPT.yaml file within the configured checkpoint path to trigger code execution during candidate discovery, even if the malicious checkpoint is never selected for recovery.

FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.2, rtmp_handle_control() rendered an RTMP user-control message into a 200-byte stack buffer using an unbounded sprintf loop controlled by the wire message length. A body of roughly 70 bytes or more overflowed the stack before any RTMP login, because the handshake authenticates neither side. The flaw affects deployments that build and load mod_rtmp, which is disabled in the stock build and configuration but commonly exposes a listener on TCP port 1935 when enabled. One unauthenticated message can crash FreeSWITCH and end every active call; the constrained ASCII hex output has not yielded control-flow hijacking. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.2.

In DragonFly BSD through 6.4.2 before 4bb22ff, the ARP input handlers arpintr() and in_arpinput() (sys/netinet/if_ether.c) do not validate the hardware address length (ar_hln) and protocol address length (ar_pln) fields of incoming ARP packets. in_arpreply() then uses these attacker-controlled values as memcpy lengths when copying from kernel buffers that are only 6 and 4 bytes long, resulting in an out-of-bounds read of kernel heap and stack memory that is copied into the ARP reply sent back to the requester. An unauthenticated attacker on the adjacent network can use a single crafted ARP request to disclose up to roughly 250 bytes of each type of kernel memory, including kernel pointers. This is expected to be fixed in the 6.6 stable release when that is available.

The List Site Contributors plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 'alpha' parameter in versions up to, and including, 1.1.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link.

PipesHub before 0.10.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ImageParser._fetch_single_url that allows attackers to make the indexing service fetch internal addresses by embedding image URLs in documents. Attackers can supply Markdown or HTML via uploads, synced mailboxes, or web connectors to reach loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata endpoints, with image responses embedded into indexed content.
An issue in Systrome Validation & Certification 1.0 allows an attacker to cause a denial of service via the t URL parameter in the qrcode_auth.html component

OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

The WP Ultimate Review WordPress plugin before 2.4.4 does not prevent unauthenticated users from storing crafted review content that makes the reviewed page fail with a fatal error on every subsequent visit, resulting in a persistent denial of service when the WP Ultimate Review WordPress plugin before 2.4.4's review display settings have never been saved.
Open 5GS WebUI uses a hard-coded JWT signing key (change-me) whenever the environment variable JWT_SECRET_KEY is unset

Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.6.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS reads Git configuration options defined for a submodule without checking certain values for embedded line-ending control characters. A malicious repository can insert control characters such as line feed (LF) into those values to mimic options that cause Git LFS to execute an attacker-controlled command or binary while fetching or adding objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

fzf is a command-line fuzzy finder. Prior to 0.74.5, bin/fzf-tmux validates separately supplied layout sizes but does not validate attached -l and -u layout values before Bash arithmetic expansion, allowing command substitution in a crafted operand to execute as the invoking user during option parsing. The same validation failure lets space-bearing popup geometry options -x, -y, -w, -h, and -p reach an unquoted tmux popup option string and inject additional tmux flags. Exploitation requires less-trusted project configuration, a wrapper, or a plugin to supply the poisoned value and requires the victim to invoke fzf-tmux; normal values are usually trusted, and the script has been superseded by built-in tmux options. This issue is fixed in version 0.74.5.

FileRise is a self-hosted web-based file manager with multi-file upload, editing, and batch operations. Prior to 3.24.0, FileRise Pro /api/pro/portals/get.php returns a configured client portal's full internal record to an unauthenticated caller who knows or guesses the portal slug. The response includes the internal storage folder path, client contact email, form settings, and upload-policy details, while the separate publicMeta.php endpoint intentionally exposes only curated branding data. Exploitation requires the Pro add-on and at least one configured portal. This issue is fixed in version 3.24.0.

Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows SQL Injection. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.
vendors: ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti.

description: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role, which every PEM agent login inherits, is a member of the PostgreSQL pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files roles on the PEM backend database. An attacker who controls any monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can read and write files on the PEM server host as the postgres operating system user. This includes the PEM certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certificates for other agents and act as them. From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents no longer hold these roles.

pip prior to v26.2.2 the certifi bundled with pip contains the compromised eMudhra certificates. Upgrading to a secure version of pip should be done either by first upgrading Python to a version that rejects the compromised intermediates (CVE-2026-115557) or use hash pinning with a known-secure version of pip. pip is not vulnerable when using a Python version that rejects the compromised certificates. See the references below for more information.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager can supply another agency's advertiser or website identifier as a report scope and obtain that entity's name in an XLS report header. Submitted scope identifiers are not checked against the manager's permitted selections. The demonstrated disclosure is limited to entity names.

Inscriptis is a Python library for converting HTML to text. From 2.0.0 until 2.7.6, when the parent is block-level, table_end_handler() in model/tag/table_tag.py writes each sibling table through HtmlElement.write_verbatim_text() in model/html_element.py; Canvas.open_block() leaves the parent padding_inline prefix on the stack, Canvas.close_block() does not remove it, and only Canvas.close_tag() calls prefix.remove_last_prefix(). Each following sibling table therefore carries forward accumulated indentation, making get_text() output grow quadratically and allowing small attacker-controlled HTML to exhaust memory in applications converting it without authentication or user interaction. This issue is fixed in 2.7.6.

Inappropriate implementation in NFC in Google Chrome on Android prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker to perform privilege escalation via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

Medplum server 5.1.4 before 5.1.42 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Binary $presigned-url operation that allows non-admin project members to overwrite other projects' Binary content. Attackers in a project linked to another project can request a signed upload URL with upload=true for a readable Binary and overwrite its stored content, since project ownership is never verified.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing SQL statement permission check in Maxsubmissions plugin in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.5, 6.0.0-6.2.2 - The SQL statement permission was not enforced when saving, importing or batch copying forms with Maxsubmissions plugin settings, allowing backend users without this permission to store arbitrary SQL statements.
IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command.

A Path Traversal vulnerability in workspace directory handling and Git integration in Google Cloud Dataform, BigQuery Studio and Colab Enterprise on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated remote attacker to read private files and create arbitrary files across tenant repositories using crafted workspace operations and Git integration requests. This vulnerability was patched on 10 October 2026, and no customer action is needed.

In iceoryx2 versions from 0.6.0 to 0.10.0, The C API getters that copy a service's hash into a caller-provided buffer (e.g. iox2_port_factory_pub_sub_service_hash and its other messaging protocol counterparts) write one byte past the end of the caller's buffer when `buffer_len` is less or equal to 40. The out-of-bounds byte is the string's NUL terminator, written at `buffer[buffer_len]`. Resolution: Resolution The bugfix is released with iceoryx2 version 0.10.1 and on main branch (commit 7ca14dd). Please note that the language bindings for C/C++ and Python (including the iceoryx2-ffi-c crate) are not published to crates.io since they are a local development dependency.

The payment notification endpoint for PayPal accepts incoming data without verifying that it comes from the payment provider. Any site visitor can overwrite the stored payment notification of an order that is still awaiting payment with arbitrary content. This requires a page that contains the shop's order plugin. Orders that are already paid are not affected.

In astro-airflow-mcp 0.5.0 through 0.9.1, the af CLI and the MCP server send telemetry from a Python subprocess that can import modules from the current working directory. If a user runs an af command or an MCP tool call from inside a project that contains an attacker-supplied json.py, that file runs with the user's privileges. Users who only run the tool in projects they trust are not affected. Fixed in 0.9.2; in earlier versions, setting AF_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 prevents it.

The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.10 via the `tpgb_ajax_register_user()` function. This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canonical `wp_capabilities` row, causing `update_user_meta()` to overwrite the newly registered user's role with `administrator`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register a new account bearing the full Administrator role, gaining complete control over the WordPress site including the ability to install plugins, modify files, and execute arbitrary code. The nonce required by the handler is publicly emitted on any page containing the tp-login-register block, making the full exploit chain — nonce retrieval, a single crafted registration POST, and the plugin's own `autologin` flow — trivially reachable on any default install where user registration is enabled. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

Phproject before 1.8.7 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability in the REST API issue endpoints (single_get, single_comments, single_comments_post) that allows authenticated API key holders to bypass the security.restrict_access confidentiality control by never invoking the allowAccess() authorization routine. Attackers can use a valid API key to read restricted issue contents and comments, including owner and author email addresses, and post unauthorized comments to issues they should not have access to.

mcp-server-kubernetes before 4.2.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows remote MCP clients to inject kubectl flags by supplying dash-prefixed values as positional operands in tools such as exec_in_pod, kubectl_patch, and kubectl_logs. Attackers connected over SSE or Streamable HTTP transport can supply values like --filename to make kubectl read files from the server host, bypassing file-read restrictions.

A memory initialization issue was addressed with improved memory handling. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2. An app may be able to disclose kernel memory.

OFFIS DCMTK 3.7.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in togglePlanarConfiguration8 and togglePlanarConfiguration16 in djcodece.cc, which compute row offsets using rows instead of columns. Attackers can supply a crafted color-by-plane DICOM image with more rows than columns that is compressed with the true-lossless JPEG codec to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes and potentially code execution.

Joomla Extension - yootheme.com - Unauthenticated remote code execution in YOOtheme Pro 5.0.0-5.0.52 - YOOtheme Pro’s publicly accessible image transformation handler incompletely binds normalized image operations and the output destination to its request signature. An unauthenticated remote attacker can reuse a signature disclosed in a legitimate public image URL, inject additional image operations, traverse out of the intended cache directory, and write an attacker-controlled PNG/PHP polyglot to an executable public media directory.

Insufficient escaping of unicode characters in query log in Neo4j Enterprise and Community editions prior to 2026.01 can lead to XSS if the user opens the logs in a tool that treats them as HTML. There is no security impact on Neo4j products, but this advisory is released as a precaution to treat the logs as plain text if using versions prior to 2026.01. Proof of concept exploit: https://github.com/JoakimBulow/CVE-2026-1337

A vulnerability was identified in Seetong T8108, T8108P, T8116 and T8232 4.6.1.4-build202604241011. The affected element is an unknown function of the component Debug Service. Such manipulation leads to improper authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.6.2.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2.13.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in USB_DeviceCdcRndisSetCommand() that trusts a host-supplied informationBufferOffset. A malicious USB host can send RNDIS SET messages for OID_GEN_CURRENT_PACKET_FILTER or OID_802_3_MULTICAST_LIST with an out-of-range offset to read and disclose device memory.

Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Attackers can append data after an extra '=' in RelayState of an intercepted or replayed Redirect-binding message, causing applications to trust the tampered value.

A security vulnerability has been detected in onyx-dot-app Onyx up to 5.0.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file web/src/app/craft/components/output-panel/PreviewTab.tsx. The manipulation leads to cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

EUSurvey 1.4.4.6738 through 1.6, prior to commit de1145c, contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the public results page GET /publication/{shortname} that allows unauthenticated attackers to infer non-public response data. ReportingService builds a SQL column expression from part of a user-supplied filter parameter name and inserts it directly into the query, so a visitor to any survey that publishes its results can inject boolean conditions and use the presence or absence of public result rows to infer private reporting data, including response data and respondent metadata from other surveys.

A vulnerability was found in humhub questions up to 1.1.5. Affected is an unknown function of the file widgets/views/answer.php of the component QA Module. Performing a manipulation of the argument displayName results in cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 1.1.6 is able to address this issue. The patch is named cdc39878ba457ca71271c1ec3cf05fe025e3e9fc. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

A flaw has been found in itsourcecode Leave Management System 1.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /module/leave/controller.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument LEAVEID can lead to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used.

CivetWeb through 1.16, when built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 on, contains a use-after-free vulnerability in handle_http2() that retains freed :method and :path pointers. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a later HEADERS frame omitting these pseudo-headers to influence request method or path seen by access rules, or crash the server.

Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved input validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, tvOS 27.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or corrupt kernel memory.

Joomla Extension - ordasoft.com - Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Real Estate Manager (Free) < 6.7.9 - site/realestatemanager.php builds the ORDER BY clause of three separate frontend property-listing queries (category browsing, search results, and the full property listing) from a request-controlled order_field parameter, concatenated directly into an unquoted SQL clause with no allow-list of real column names and no cast.
products: Real Estate Manager (Free) extension for Joomla

description: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in Drupal AlternativeCommerce PayPal Checkout allows Signature Spoof. This issue affects AlternativeCommerce PayPal Checkout versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.1.

Memory overflow vulnerability leading to Remote Code Execution or Denial of Service Vulnerability in NetScaler ADC. NetScaler ADC or NetScaler Gateway must be configured as a SAML SP or SAML IdP, subject to the following version-specific requirements: * For the following versions: Applicable only when configured as a SAML IdP: * NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway between 14.1-73.37 and 14.1-73.41, inclusive * NetScaler ADC 14.1-FIPS between 14.1-73.37 FIPS and 14.1-73.41 FIPS, inclusive * NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway between 13.1-64.23 and 13.1-64.28, inclusive * NetScaler ADC 13.1-FIPS between 13.1-NDcPP 13.1-37.279 and 13.1- 37.282, inclusive For the following versions: Applicable only when configured as a SAML SP or SAML IdP: * NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway before 14.1-73.37 * NetScaler ADC 14.1-FIPS before 14.1-73.37 FIPS * NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway before 13.1-64.23 * NetScaler ADC 13.1-FIPS before13.1-NDcPP 13.1-37.279

filelock is a platform-independent file lock for Python. From 3.20.4 until 4.0.9, ReadWriteLock and AsyncReadWriteLock versions from 3.20.4 resolve the lock path and pass it to SQLite without rejecting a final symbolic link, allowing another local user who can create names in the lock directory to redirect database creation and locking or split mutual exclusion between targets. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.9.

Tabularis before 0.28.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its SQLite driver that allows MCP clients to execute stacked statements by supplying a crafted table_name to the describe_table tool. Attackers, including AI agents steered by untrusted content, can close the quoted PRAGMA argument and append statements to read, modify, or drop SQLite data, bypassing read-only mode and write approval.

MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From 10.6.1 until 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2, MariaDB insufficiently validated counts, offsets, lengths, and field boundaries in FRM metadata while opening binary FRM files. An attacker able to place a crafted FRM file in the data directory could trigger out-of-bounds reads or writes, crash the server, or potentially execute code. This issue is fixed in versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal GraphQL Core Schema allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects GraphQL Core Schema versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.29.

The FlowForms – Conversational Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.1 via the update_form due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to modify the content, design, and settings of, as well as publish or revert, any form on the site — including forms owned by administrators — by supplying an arbitrary form ID in the REST URL.

In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the row-level security policies on pem.job and pem.jobstep that apply to PEM agents do not limit an agent to its own jobs. An attacker who controls one monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can create, change or delete jobs for every other agent, including the agent on the PEM server. Agents run SQL job steps with the database credentials of the server they monitor, and shell job steps where batch jobs are enabled, so compromising one monitored host can give superuser SQL access to every monitored database and to the PEM backend. From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents can no longer create jobs or change job definitions or job steps.

Caddy – WooCommerce Side Cart & Free Shipping Bar plugin for WordPress 3.0.0 before 3.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saved-items/add REST endpoint that exposes non-public product data. Authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access can enumerate product_id values to read names, prices, images and stock status of private, draft, hidden and password-protected products.
products: Caddy – WooCommerce Side Cart & Free Shipping Bar

description: Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When converting from UCS-4, these encoders may encounter a combining base such as U+00E6 and jump ahead by 4 bytes to check the next UCS-4 code point. The check for end of buffer however does not account for this, which may result in a buffer overread if the following code point has less than 4 bytes remaining. Exploitation of this bug not only requires attacker control of input and encoding, but also strict control over layout of the input in memory.

Joomla! Core - [20261107] - Core - Insufficient file extension checks in com_media rename and copy actions in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The rename and copy actions of the local media adapter only validate the final file extension, allowing files with a blocked extension in their name.

Contrast (edgelesssys/contrast) versions 1.14.0 before 1.23.1 generate runtime policies that fail to detect all container image substitutions. A bad rebase during a Kata Containers update accidentally introduced an `allow_storage` rule that accepts storage entries using the `image_guest_pull` driver without verifying the image digest. An attacker with access to the Kata agent API — for example, a Kubernetes cluster administrator in Contrast's threat model — can therefore substitute a container image with an exploit payload, provided the substituted image satisfies the remaining policy rules, undermining the confidential container's integrity guarantees.

A flaw has been found in BerriAI LiteLLM up to 1.95.0. Affected by this issue is the function ui_view_session_spend_logs of the file litellm/proxy/spend_tracking/spend_management_endpoints.py of the component Spend Tracking. Executing a manipulation of the argument session_id can lead to authorization bypass. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.96.0 can resolve this issue. This patch is called 722d9ffa4f6c5ae15702ab9ab2c5f6bf1688308b. The affected component should be upgraded.

The LearnPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 4.4.10 via deserialization of untrusted input from the 'checkout-email' request parameter during the checkout AJAX action. The value is passed through sanitize_text_field(), which does not strip serialized object syntax, then stored in the LearnPress session table and later fed to LP_Helper::maybe_unserialize() → unserialize() (without an allowed_classes restriction) by LP_Session_Handler::get() on subsequent requests. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object.
products: LearnPress – WordPress LMS Plugin for Create and Sell Online Courses

description: A path traversal vulnerability was identified TP-Link Tapo C260 v1, D235 v1, C211 v2 and C520WS v2.6 within the HTTP server’s handling of GET requests. The server performs path normalization before fully decoding URL encoded input and falls back to using the raw path when normalization fails. An attacker can exploit this logic flaw by supplying crafted, URL encoded traversal sequences that bypass directory restrictions and allow access to files outside the intended web root. Successful exploitation may allow authenticated attackers to get disclosure of sensitive system files and credentials, while unauthenticated attackers may gain access to non-sensitive static assets.

An integer overflow in the remote-control screen processing component of TeamViewer clients (Full Client, Portable and Remote Control App) prior to version 15.83 may allow a malicious remote host to cause a denial of service or, depending on the platform, potentially execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the viewer process. Exploitation requires a user to establish a remote-control session to an attacker-controlled or compromised host.

blob42 gosuki through commit 6e2bf34 contains a Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. The application uses text/template instead of html/template, failing to perform context-aware auto-escaping on the URL and DisplayURL fields of bookmarks in internal/webui/templates/bookmarks.html. An attacker can craft a malicious bookmark URL containing HTML attribute-breaking payloads that execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser context when rendered in the local web interface.

A vulnerability was identified in getkirby Kirby up to 4.9.5/5.5.3. Affected by this issue is the function OptionsQuery::resolve of the file src/Option/OptionsQuery.php of the component Dynamic Option Generation. The manipulation leads to authorization bypass. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 4.9.6 and 5.6.0 can resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component.

Qbian61 forum-java commit 20f7e68 through commit 63152c4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by posting unsanitized comment content rendered via jQuery .html() in the reply dialog. Attackers can post comments with img onerror payloads that execute when victims click Reply, stealing the non-HttpOnly sid session cookie to hijack accounts including administrators.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, ToolboxSettings.parse builds a deeply nested attacker-controlled settings tree iteratively, but the later public helpers to_settings_string, remove_blanks, add_default_fields, sort_fields, and add_blank_lines recursively traverse that tree without a depth bound. Invoking any of those helpers on input nested beyond the interpreter recursion limit can raise RecursionError and abort the operation or request worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Authentication Methods Portal Extension allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

The decompress package for Node.js extracts archives. Prior to 10.2.2 and 11.1.4, the default decompress(input, output) API relies on lexical containment checks that do not account for the kernel following a planted symlink chain. An attacker can supply a crafted archive containing chained symlink entries so that a later entry resolves outside the output directory. This allows files outside output to be read or written, and overwriting startup scripts or configuration can lead to remote code execution. The maintained @xhmikosr/decompress package is fixed in 10.2.2 and 11.1.4, but the separately affected unmaintained decompress package remains unpatched through 4.2.1. This vulnerability results from a bypass of the incomplete hardening for CVE-2026-53486. @xhmikosr/decompress is fixed in versions 10.2.2 and 11.1.4.

WebToffee Product Feed before 2.4.4 for WordPress contains a use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the URL-cron signature check by computing a valid hash using the publicly known constant salt embedded in the plugin source. Attackers can send forged GET requests with attacker-controlled parameters to the unauthenticated init-hooked endpoint to repeatedly trigger product-feed generation, causing CPU/database resource exhaustion and overwriting of the generated feed file.
products: WebToffee WooCommerce Product Feeds – Google Shopping, Pinterest, TikTok Ads, & More

description: A vulnerability was detected in eigent-ai eigent up to 1.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file backend/app/controller/chat_controller.py of the component Local Agent Control API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.3 addresses this issue. The patch is named 59f43afcb1b0ba7b2de8c65d585124f196c4aa17. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

Joomla Extension - ordasoft.com - Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Book Library (Free) < 6.4.6 - site/booklibrary.php’s books() function reads the field and direction request parameters and passes each through a function called protectInjectionWithoutQuote(), whose only real protection is a keyword blacklist that, on detecting the literal substring select, wraps the value in $db->quote() instead of rejecting it. The value is then concatenated directly into an unquoted ORDER BY clause, a position where quoting provides no protection at all. Reaching the vulnerable code path requires two conditions: a first request to prime session-stored sort defaults, and a trailing decoy comment (-- xselect) that satisfies the blacklist’s substring check without altering the payload’s effect.

Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.
vendors: ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti.

description: Slims (Senayan Library Management Systems) 9 Bulian 9.8.0 allows cross-site request forgery (CSRF) against admin/modules/circulation/loan_history_maintenance.php because the action=run GET parameter performs privileged, destructive operations with no CSRF token or POST confirmation, leading to data loss of loan history records.

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%. Impact: System performance can degrade until the NGINX worker process is either forced to restart or is manually restarted. This vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a degradation of service that can lead to a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

OS command injection in Ivanti Sentry before versions 11.0.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 as well as in Ivanti EPMM before versions 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to achieve remote code execution.

Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. Prior to 36.0.19 and 43.0.0, the Cranelift compiler backend bit-packs SSA value indices in a way that can silently overflow in release builds when compiling a sufficiently large or specially crafted Wasm function with many SSA values. The overflow can make Cranelift reference incorrect IR values, causing arbitrary miscompilation, type confusion, and other attacker-controlled effects that may escape the Wasm sandbox on any architecture using the default Cranelift backend. This issue is fixed in versions 36.0.19 and 43.0.0.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce Product Alternative allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Commerce Product Alternative versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.1.

The Model Context Protocol TypeScript SDK provides TypeScript client and server implementations of the Model Context Protocol. From 2.0.0 until 2.3.0 in @modelcontextprotocol/server, applications that shared one stateless HTTP transport or one McpServer or Server instance among multiple clients could deliver responses and notifications to the wrong client. The affected surface is an MCP server reached over HTTP by multiple clients. The trigger is reuse of one stateless transport or server instance. Messages were associated with a connection using only the JSON-RPC request identifier. SDK clients start request identifiers at zero, so collisions occur in normal operation. Cross-client delivery exposes one client's responses and notifications to another client. The issue requires an HTTP endpoint reachable by more than one client and an application that constructs the server or transport once at startup instead of once per request or session. stdio servers and factory-created per-call servers are not affected.
