Attackers can brute-force login credentials via POST /api/tokens and subsequently guess TOTP codes via POST /api/tokens/2fa to gain full session access and administrative control.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.8 before 19.0.6, 19.1 before 19.1.4, and 19.2 before 19.2.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to achieve remote code execution due to a path traversal vulnerability in the package registry.

@twilio-labs/netlify-okta-auth through 1.0.2 relies on an unverified iss claim. This affects an outbound HTTP request to retrieve a public signing key. There may be other impacts in a misconfiguration where oktaUrl isn't set.

On Debian, Ubuntu, and derivative Linux distributions, an on-path attacker who can manipulate the HTTP traffic (including a malicious mirror or proxy) between an APT client and an archive server triggered by a package install can trick the client into installing an attacker-controlled unverified package and achieve remote code execution with root privileges. The vulnerability is caused by the reuse of hard links and requires the client to follow redirects and retry the download of package files. It requires the client to have a non-zero Acquire::Retries configuration setting; the value 3 is the default starting with Debian 12 (bookworm) and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish), so older releases are unaffected in a default configuration
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Paragraphs Edit allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Paragraphs Edit versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.0.2.

Product Gallery Slider & Additional Variation Images for WooCommerce 2.3.23 before 2.3.26 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Codestar backup AJAX actions csf-export, csf-import and csf-reset. Shop Managers can read the csf_backup_nonce from the settings page and supply arbitrary option names via the 'unique' parameter to read, overwrite or delete WordPress options, including modifying wp_user_roles to escalate to administrator.
products: Product Gallery Slider & Additional Variation Images for WooCommerce

description: A weakness has been identified in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file orc8r/cloud/go/services/obsidian/access/operator.go of the component Obsidian REST. Executing a manipulation of the argument X-Magma-Client-Cert-Serial can lead to authentication bypass by spoofing. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
Incorrect boundary conditions in the JavaScript Engine component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 158, Firefox ESR 115.43, Firefox ESR 153.5, Thunderbird 158, and Thunderbird 153.5.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal S3 File System CORS Upload allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects S3 File System CORS Upload versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.4.0.
Kernel driver ProcessMonitorDriver.sys in Safetica's endpoint client x64 , versions 10.5.75.0 and 11.11.4.0, allows unprivileged user to abuse IOCTL path and terminate protected system processes.

In adbd_tls_verify_cert of auth.cpp, there is a possible bypass of wireless ADB mutual authentication due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution as the shell user with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

ArcadeDB native-image server builds 26.8.1 before 26.11.1 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clients to perform writes through read-only query paths by nesting statements in SELECT. Missing reflection metadata leaves SqlAstInspector with an empty AST, letting INSERT in projections or LET clauses persist via the query endpoint, MCP read-only mode, and HA follower routing.

The Orphans plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a two-step comment chain: a benign first comment must be approved under a given name and email so that WordPress's comment_previously_approved mechanism auto-publishes the attacker's payload comment without moderation.

In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.0.0 to 2.0.22 and 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the return value of password hash functions for sha512-pbkdf2 and legacy sha512 were not checked. Starting with OpenSSL 4.0, sha512-pbkdf2 hashing will fail when using the FIPS provider for passwords shorter than 8 characters. This has the effect that newly created passwords would match against any other password with fewer than 8 characters.

Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution. In non-thread-safe builds, a diagnostic written to a file-based error_log during module startup, for example for an invalid date.timezone value or a session configuration warning, causes the timezone cache to be allocated in startup memory that is freed while a reference to it is kept. A diagnostic raised early in the first request of a worker, such as the max_input_vars warning, then accesses the freed cache. On such a deployment an unauthenticated remote attacker can crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers with a crafted request. Arbitrary code execution may be possible and has been demonstrated with known memory addresses. This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

A vulnerability was detected in code-projects Student Details Management System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /index.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument roll results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

A command injection vulnerability exists in mlflow/mlflow when serving a model with `enable_mlserver=True`. The `model_uri` is embedded directly into a shell command executed via `bash -c` without proper sanitization. If the `model_uri` contains shell metacharacters, such as `$()` or backticks, it allows for command substitution and execution of attacker-controlled commands. This vulnerability affects the latest version of mlflow/mlflow and can lead to privilege escalation if a higher-privileged service serves models from a directory writable by lower-privileged users.

A flaw in the connection management layer of the MongoDB Node.js driver can leave a pooled network connection in the pool for reuse while data from an earlier operation is still outstanding on it. In applications that enable an optional client-side operation timeout, an unauthenticated party that can send ordinary requests to the application may cause database replies to be paired with the wrong requests. This may result in unintended disclosure of other users' records, incorrect operation results being returned, and failures of legitimate requests.

A security flaw has been discovered in BKWLD Decoy up to 5.11.1. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file Policy.php of the component Authorization Policy. The manipulation of the argument role results in improper privilege management. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, DependencyGraph.tree and DependencyGraph.triples walk parsed dependency edges through unbounded Python recursion and do not use a working cycle or depth guard. A crafted CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency file containing a sufficiently long chain can raise RecursionError when the documented traversal APIs are called, aborting the current worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

The Simple File List plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file modification due to insufficient authorization checks in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.7. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete and modify files on the serve. This vulnerability is exploitable even when the administrator has not enabled the AllowFrontManage setting, because the is_admin() check unconditionally short-circuits the guard before that setting is evaluated.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.10.0 until 3.10.4, allowlisted_pickle_load keys dangerous NumPy globals by export name, allowing submodule-local numpy.lib file input/output callables to evade the denylist under the broad module allowance used by TransitionParser. A crafted pickle can invoke recfromtxt to read a local file or open_memmap to create or truncate an attacker-selected file when a victim loads an untrusted model. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /usr/sbin/upgrade_flash.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument boundary results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor explains: ""I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know."

Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - RCE through file upload in jDownloads < 4.1.8 - Insufficient validation of frontend thumbnail uploads allowed users with upload permission to place executable files on the server. This results in PHP code execution.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an authentication-bypass-by-replay vulnerability in the NAS NDMP service that could allow a network attacker to gain backup and restore control of the appliance.

In isPackageNullOrSystem of AppOpsService.java, there is a possible persistent denial of service due to improper input validation. This could lead to local denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

A command injection vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated administrator to bypass system restrictions and run arbitrary commands as a root user. To be able to exploit this issue, the user must have access to the PAN-OS CLI or Web UI. The security risk posed by this issue is significantly minimized when CLI access is restricted to a limited group of administrators and by restricting access to the management web interface to only trusted internal IP addresses according to our recommended best practice deployment guidelines https://live.paloaltonetworks.com/t5/community-blogs/tips-amp-tricks-how-to-secure-the-management-access-of-your-palo/ba-p/464431 . This issue is applicable to PAN-OS software on PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls and on Panorama (virtual and M-Series). Cloud NGFW and Prisma® Access are not affected by this vulnerability.

sigstore-js @sigstore/oci before 0.8.0 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that leaks registry credentials by replaying OAuth2 password-grant request bodies on cross-origin 307 or 308 redirects. Attackers who can make a trusted token service redirect to their host via open redirect or compromise receive the username and password POSTed by RegistryClient.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in BuddyPress BuddyPress buddypress allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects BuddyPress: from n/a through 14.5.2.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, Prover9Parent.config_prover9 and Mace accept a relative binary_location and pass it to find_binary as path_to_bin, disabling the bare-name absolute-path guard. A local attacker who can plant prover9 or mace4 in the resolved working directory can cause subprocess.Popen to execute that binary with the invoking user's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

Rclone before 1.75.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in serve webdav that allows unauthenticated attackers to write above the served root by sending an unvalidated '..' path component. Attackers can send MKCOL /.. to plant a VFS node, then PUT, MOVE, COPY, or MKCOL to create, overwrite, or delete files belonging to other tenants.

AJ-Report through 1.7.1 signs share tokens with a hard-coded JWT secret, allowing attackers to forge valid Share-Tokens offline. Attackers can mint a token with reportCode 'dataSet' to access the testTransform endpoint, which passes scripts to GroovyClassLoader for unauthenticated remote code execution.

Formance Ledger 2.2.0-beta.3 before 2.4.18 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote API callers to execute SQL by supplying unvalidated account expand values. Attackers can inject comment-separated SQL through the expand query parameter or base64 pagination cursor to run queries with the ledger database role's privileges.

storyblok-backup is an npx CLI tool to create backups of a Storyblok space and restore individual resources. Prior to 0.7.1, the writeJson function used the editable Storyblok component name field as a filename without path containment. A person with component-management access in a Storyblok space could store a component name containing path traversal sequences; when another user later ran a backup for that space, the stored name escaped the configured backup directory and caused a JSON file to be written outside it on the backup host. Depending on the path chosen and the backup process's permissions, this could overwrite existing files at attacker-chosen locations. The vulnerability is specific to components: stories and datasources use numeric identifiers, and asset names are reduced to a final path segment. This issue is fixed in version 0.7.1.

AiSOC before 23.6.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the agents service that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' investigation runs by supplying their run_id. Attackers can query GET /api/v1/investigations/{run_id}, report variants, the WebSocket stream, or agent-runs routes to obtain audit logs, forensic output, and incident reports.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

Okou API before 1.762.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in its Microsoft Teams, legacy Slack, and GitHub App integration OAuth flows that trusts caller-supplied userId and orgId values. Unauthenticated attackers who know a member's identifiers can complete the flow with their own external account to bind that identity or installation to the victim's Okou user and organization.

Sim 0.5.61 before 0.9.41 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows write-level workspace members to change workflow MCP server visibility without admin permission. Attackers can set isPublic via POST or PATCH to /api/mcp/workflow-servers, exposing deployed workflows to unauthenticated invocation through /api/mcp/serve.

In onHeaderDecoded of LocalImageResolver.java, there is a possible persistent denial of service due to resource exhaustion. This could lead to local denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. From 2.3.8 until 2.5.0, an authenticated administrator with an active secure session can submit attacker-controlled portable backup key material and a matching manifest to POST /api/restore. The restore flow trusts the supplied key, decrypts attacker-controlled contents, and replaces the live app.ini, including protected nginx command settings such as TestConfigCmd. Triggering POST /api/nginx/test then executes the restored command in the Nginx UI runtime context, affecting confidentiality, integrity, and availability. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.0.

Codefriar sf-mcp through 1.3.2 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute shell commands by supplying crafted Salesforce CLI tool flag values. Because escapeValue() in src/utils.ts fails to neutralize backticks, $() substitution, and other shell metacharacters, these values reach execSync in executeSfCommand and run as the MCP server user.

An attacker must control pagination data returned by an upstream API or service queried by an existing REST Collector. The Collector must use affected response-based pagination and process the crafted data during a job run. Successful exploitation executes code with the Worker service account's permissions.

The Logo Slider – Logo Carousel, Client Logo Slider & Brand Showcase for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'lgx_tooltip_position' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.
products: Logo Slider WP – Responsive Logo Carousel, Logo Gallery & Logo Showcase

description: Out-of-bounds write possible in Git when git-merge(1) used on tag with more than two GPG signatures

A vulnerability was detected in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17/2.17b02. Affected by this vulnerability is the function authenticationcgi_main of the file authentication.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument id/password results in stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used.
Integer overflow in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.78 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

A security vulnerability has been detected in HeyCyan App 1.0.103 on Android. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the component FileProvider. The manipulation leads to improper access controls. The attack may be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

On Scalable Platforms, an administrator with permissions to edit and install the Access Control Policy and NAT rules can create a NAT rule that redirects traffic to the Gateway's Sync interface, bypassing the built-in Sync protection. This could allow the administrator to execute operating system commands and write files on the Gateway with superuser privileges.
Path traversal in Git allows writing to arbitrary file via cloning and committing to bad repository

FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in update_gdi_patblt(), update_gdi_polygon_cb() and update_gdi_mem3blt() that retain stale brush cache pointers. A malicious RDP server can resend CACHE_BRUSH to the same slot then send PATBLT, causing clients to read freed heap memory, disclosing data or crashing.
AUTOM8N (WHM/cPanel plugin) through commit 82821f7 contains an OS Command Injection in borg_restore.cgi.

A logic issue was addressed with improved state management. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, visionOS 27.2. An malicious app may be able to bypass certificate validation.

The cleanup of tempfile.TemporaryDirectory is vulnerable to a race condition. An attacker who can modify the tree during cleanup can replace a directory with a symbolic link, causing files outside of the temporary directory to be deleted or have their permissions and file flags reset, with the privileges of the process performing the cleanup. Note that platforms where shutil.rmtree.avoids_symlink_attacks is false, remain affected, and file flags may still be reset outside of the tree on all platforms.

The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.26.4 via the UpdraftPlus_Remote_Communications_V2::wp_loaded function. This is due to insufficient validation of the remote communications message format, where signature verification can be bypassed and unchecked decryption return values collapse to a predictable all-zero encryption key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to forge arbitrary RPC commands and run them as the connected administrator, such as uploading and activating a malicious plugin, which ultimately leads to remote code execution.

A path handling issue was addressed with improved validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to gain root privileges.

Tolgee before 3.242.5 fails to enforce email verification on the TOTP enable and recovery-code regeneration endpoints, allowing attackers to enroll MFA on unverified accounts via the @BypassEmailVerification annotation. Attackers can register with a victim's email, enroll an attacker-controlled TOTP factor through PUT /v2/user/mfa/totp, and permanently lock the legitimate owner out after verification and password reset.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Tribulant Software Newsletters newsletters-lite allows Object Injection.This issue affects Newsletters: from n/a through 4.18.2.

The JetFormBuilder — Dynamic Blocks Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.2. This is due to the plugin not validating that a submitted form ID belongs to a JetFormBuilder form before parsing the referenced post's content as form schema and executing an Advanced Validation server-side callback. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create a new administrator-level user account.

TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.2.0, the User extension’s onRequestResetPassword() handler in src/Http/Controllers/Login.php calls resetPassword() and mailSendResetPasswordRequest() only when an account matches. The resulting database write and reset-email send take longer than the nonexistent-account path despite the endpoint returning the same response, allowing timing measurements against a production deployment using a synchronous queue and real SMTP transport to disclose valid staff or customer email addresses. The advisory’s local log-mailer test showed no measurable timing difference, so the signal depends on mail configuration and is useful for follow-on phishing or credential stuffing rather than direct account access. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.0.

Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit edb5021, contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the GET /settings/shareEdit/{shareId} and POST /settings/shares handlers that allows any authenticated user to read or modify another user's contact share. The ownership check in SettingsController denies access only when a condition is both true and false, so it never denies access, allowing an ordinary account without Contact Management privileges to read the names and email addresses in a share and to rename it, change its recipient or access mode, or replace its contacts.

Issue summary: Calling EVP_EncodeBlock() with an input length close to INT_MAX may overflow the calculation of the encoded output size and write past the end of the caller-supplied output buffer. Impact summary: No path by which an attacker can trigger this has been identified. An application that passes an input length near INT_MAX to EVP_EncodeBlock() could suffer a heap buffer overflow, crashing or corrupting its own memory, but it must itself supply such a length. CWE: CWE-190: Integer Overflow or Wraparound Description: EVP_EncodeBlock() base64-encodes a buffer of a caller-supplied length into an output buffer that the caller allocates. The caller is expected to reserve 4*((len+2)/3)+1 bytes. For input lengths close to INT_MAX, the arithmetic that computes the encoded length overflows a signed integer, so the function writes more data than the documented output size. The result is a heap buffer overflow in the calling process. Reaching this requires an application to pass an input length near INT_MAX to EVP_EncodeBlock(). OpenSSL's TLS, QUIC and CMS implementations never encode buffers of that size, and the command line tools cannot practically be made to do so: the limits on reading a proxy password from a file and on bignum sizes prevent it. An application that accepts an attacker-controlled length and forwards it to EVP_EncodeBlock() without its own bound check is exposed. The severity is Low because no attacker-controlled path to the overflow is known. The caller must already hold a buffer of about two gigabytes before the defect can be reached. FIPS impact: no The affected code is outside the FIPS module boundary.
Inappropriate implementation in Downloads in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker to perform UI spoofing via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

THC-Hydra through 9.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in analyze_server_response() of hydra-http-form.c that allows malicious HTTP servers to corrupt memory via crafted Set-Cookie headers. Attackers can send a Set-Cookie header with an extra leading space followed by a repeated cookie name, causing a negative strncpy length that overflows tmpcookie and crashes Hydra.

A Pre-authentication SSRF vulnerability exists in the SMA1000 Appliance Work Place interface due to an unintended alternate access path. By abusing this path, a remote unauthenticated attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability to direct the appliance to issue requests on their behalf and reach internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

RustDesk Client for Windows reg_recovery Missing Authorization Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of RustDesk Client for Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the main IPC endpoint exposed by the RustDesk service. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-34805.

A code execution vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Checkov by Prisma® Cloud can allow arbitrary code execution when Checkov scans a directory that contains an attacker-controlled configuration file.

aMQTT is an open source MQTT broker and client. From 0.11.0 until 0.12.1, the QoS 2 transaction handler in amqtt/mqtt/protocol/handler.py, _handle_qos2_message_flow(), can retain transaction state and packet identifiers when a client disconnects before the handshake completes, unlike QoS 1 flows that expire after the default five-second timeout. A remote client can repeatedly begin QoS 2 flows and disconnect without maintaining long-lived connections; anonymous clients can do this with the default configuration, while authenticated deployments remain affected when a client may initiate QoS 2 flows. The retained state grows broker memory until resource exhaustion can terminate the process; no confidentiality or integrity impact is identified. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.1.

The Friendly Functions for Welcart plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.5. This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the settings page. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to update plugin settings via a forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link.

fast-jwt provides fast JSON Web Token (JWT) implementation. Prior to 6.3.1, fast-jwt createVerifier accepts an unsigned JWT when key is an empty string or null and algorithms is a non-empty allowlist. Falsy synchronous keys bypass prepareKeyOrSecret, allowedAlgorithms remains active, hasKey is false, and the empty signature avoids the verifySignature gate. An attacker can therefore submit a token containing arbitrary claims without possessing a signing key, resulting in authentication or authorization bypass. Claim validators still run, and non-empty keys, an empty key without algorithms, and the async key resolver path do not have this behavior. This issue is fixed in version 6.3.1.

TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.3.1, the Mollie payment notification handler in src/Payments/Mollie.php, processNotifyUrl(), uses a payment ID supplied with the notification to retrieve a paid transaction but does not verify that the transaction's order reference matches the order identified by the notification URL or that the transaction amount matches the order total. An ordinary customer can use a paid Mollie transaction from one order to cause a different, higher-value order to be marked paid without paying its full price. The endpoint is intentionally unauthenticated so Mollie's servers can reach it, and the request's order hash alone does not bind the fetched payment to that order. This issue is fixed in version 4.3.1.

The Bit integrations – Form Integration, Webhook, Spreadsheets, CRM, LMS & Email Automation plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.7 via the upload_attachment. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to make web requests to arbitrary locations originating from the web application and can be used to query and modify information from internal services. Exploitation requires a form integration to be configured with a field mapped to a WooCommerce product image, product gallery, downloadable files, or Google Contacts attachment field, which is a default use case for these integrations.
products: Bit integrations – Form Integration, Webhook, Spreadsheets, CRM, LMS & Email Automation

description: Go-Guerrilla SMTP Daemon is a lightweight SMTP server written in Go. In 1.6.7 and earlier, according to the repository advisory's structured affected range, server.go defines the seven-byte cmdXCLIENT token, but the XCLIENT handler slices input[8:] after matching only that seven-byte verb, so a bare command causes an out-of-bounds panic in handleClient and terminates the daemon because that connection goroutine does not recover the panic. The issue is reachable by an unauthenticated client when the non-default xclient_on setting is enabled; no HELO command is required. The repository fix is present in version 1.6.7-1.

Slims (Senayan Library Management Systems) 9 Bulian 9.8.0 allows an authenticated staff user to perform SQL injection via the opac_hide and promoted GET parameters of admin/modules/bibliography/index.php, because escape_string() is applied but the values are concatenated into an unquoted numeric SQL context, leading to error-based information disclosure and arbitrary data extraction.
Improper access control in Azure Site Recovery allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Exposure of sensitive information through data queries vulnerability in The Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki PageTriage extension allows Information Elicitation. This issue affects MediaWiki PageTriage extension: 1.46, 1.45, and 1.43.

The Podlove Podcast Publisher plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file uploads due to missing file type validation in the 'podlove_handle_cache_files' function in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.1. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files on the affected site's server which may make remote code execution possible.

Laravel is a web application framework. Prior to 12.68.0 and 13.29.0, TokenGuard configured as a standard token-based API guard does not reject a crafted non-string credential. Under affected MySQL or MariaDB configurations, the authentication lookup can match an unintended existing user, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and take over an account on routes protected by TokenGuard. This issue is fixed in versions 12.68.0 and 13.29.0.

The WP Ultimate Review WordPress plugin before 2.4.4 does not escape some of its review overview settings before outputting them in posts, which could allow users with a role as low as author to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks, when author reviews are enabled.

The gist RubyGem before 6.1.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows on-path attackers to intercept HTTPS traffic because http_connection in lib/gist.rb sets VERIFY_NONE. Attackers can present any certificate to read or modify GitHub API traffic, stealing OAuth tokens and login credentials to read and modify the victim's gists.

A repository created with auto-init accepted pushes before its initialization had finished, and the initial commit was built in a checkout of whatever the repository already contained. A user who is allowed to create repositories could push a crafted tree during that window so that writing the README followed a symbolic link and overwrote a server-side git hook, which runs commands as the Gitea system user. The initial commit is now built in a freshly initialized directory, and a new repository only becomes ready, and accepts pushes, once its initialization is complete.
Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Office PowerPoint allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

Echo is a Go web framework. Prior to 4.16.0 and 5.4.0, a globally mounted middleware.Static instance can interpret an encoded request path differently from Echo's router because the router matches the still-encoded path while the static handler uses the decoded URL.Path. The advisory demonstrates an encoded slash resolving to a file under the static root through the global static middleware, but the source is internally inconsistent about whether a route or group guard protects the corresponding literal path in that global-mount configuration. This issue is fixed in 4.16.0 and 5.4.0.

XWEB EVO versions 5.2.3 through before 5.7.0 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the username field of login.lua, cleanout.lua, or api.lua before the password check occurs. Attackers can exploit this flaw combined with the setuid-root wlua interpreter to execute commands with root privileges, achieving full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

Vulnerability in the MySQL Connectors product of Oracle MySQL (component: Connector/J). The supported version that is affected is 26.7.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Connectors. Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of MySQL Connectors. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.3 (Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L).

vm2 before 3.12.2 contains an authorization bypass in the NodeVM external-module resolver. When an embedder configures `require.external` with a custom resolver (and `context: 'host'`), `LegacyResolver.customResolve` in lib/resolver-compat.js records the resolved module directory in `this.externals` as `new RegExp('^' + escapeRegExp(resolvedPath))`, without requiring a path separator or end-of-string boundary. Untrusted guest code can therefore require the allowlisted module (e.g. `foo`) and then require the absolute path of a non-allowlisted sibling whose path merely shares the resolved prefix (e.g. `.../node_modules/foo2/index.js`); the sibling passes `isPathAllowedForModule` and is loaded through `hostRequire`, so its top-level code runs in the host process before the exports are wrapped with `vm.readonly`, resulting in a sandbox escape and arbitrary code execution in the host context.

Improper neutralization of Script-Related HTML tags in a web page (basic XSS) vulnerability in The Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki MediaSearch extension allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects MediaWiki MediaSearch extension: 1.46, 1.45, and 1.43.

Directus before 12.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip permission checks by sending a failed auth message on public-mode WebSocket connections. Attackers can send an invalid token so handleAuthRequest sets accountability to null, then read, create, update or delete records in any user-defined collection.

In multiple locations, there is a possible tapjacking due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This is due to the plugin splicing the attacker-controlled request URI into a PHP expression inside a double-quoted string and evaluating it with eval(). Because PHP interpolates double-quoted strings, a payload of the form {${...}} in the URL path is executed during interpolation, so no quote breakout is required and WordPress' slashing does not mitigate it. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.

A flaw was found in QEMU's NBD server. A remote attacker can crash a multi-export NBD server process by exploiting stale metadata export state during an extended BLOCK_STATUS request, resulting in an assertion failure and denial of service.

Windmill 1.607.0 before 1.819.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace members to resume or cancel suspended flows in other workspaces by abusing the jobs_u/resume and jobs_u/cancel endpoints. Attackers can mint a resume signature for an arbitrary job id via their own workspace's job_signature endpoint to approve or cancel another workspace's suspended flow steps.

Joomla Extension - balbooa.com - Unauthenticated RCE via field shortcode injection in Balbooa Forms < 2.4.3.4 - Balbooa Forms supports administrator-defined PHP code which runs after a public form submission. The feature also supports form-field shortcodes inside that PHP. Before calling `eval()`, the component replaces each shortcode with the raw value submitted by the visitor, leading to an RCE vector. A public form must use the product's optional PHP-after-submission action and interpolate an attacker-controlled field shortcode inside a double-quoted PHP string to be vulnerable.

Use-after-free in magic method backtraces can lead to remote code execution. When collecting the arguments of a method call handled by __call() or __callStatic() for a backtrace, PHP can read stale values that may refer to freed memory. If a fatal error such as exceeding memory_limit occurs while an application enters such a call, with fatal_error_backtraces enabled (the default) and zend.exception_ignore_args disabled, a remote attacker who controls enough request data to influence memory allocation may cause memory corruption, crash the PHP worker or, with knowledge of memory addresses, execute arbitrary code. php.ini-production enables zend.exception_ignore_args, which prevents this. This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

ServiceNow has addressed a remote code execution vulnerability that was identified in the ServiceNow AI platform. This vulnerability could enable an unauthenticated user, in certain circumstances, to execute code within the ServiceNow Sandbox. ServiceNow addressed this vulnerability by deploying a security update to hosted instances. Relevant security updates also have been provided to ServiceNow self-hosted customers and partners. Further, the vulnerability is addressed in the listed patches and hot fixes. While we are not currently aware of exploitation against customer instances, we recommend customers promptly apply appropriate updates or upgrade if they have not already done so.

Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that records bank clearance dates, which checks only a broad role permission before writing to caller-named payment documents. Authenticated Accounts Users can send crafted requests naming payment documents of other companies, outside their User Permissions, or already submitted, to alter clearance dates and compromise bank reconciliation integrity.

FrankenPHP Docker images before 1.1.11 were rebuilt only when new base image tags were created, so security fixes that Alpine, PHP, and Go applied under existing tags were not propagated. Remote attackers could exploit known flaws in the stale system libraries, such as CVE-2025-15467 in libcrypto3, to execute code.

SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a capability check bypass in its embedded JavaScript scripting engine, where the surrealdb.functions bridge calls the internal fnc::synchronous() and fnc::asynchronous() dispatchers without enforcing function capability checks. Authenticated users denied access to built-in functions in SurrealQL can execute them by calling them through surrealdb.functions from embedded JavaScript.

The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 via deserialization of untrusted input in the course importer. The set_post_metas() method calls maybe_unserialize() on attacker-controlled postmeta string values parsed from the uploaded JSON import file. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP Objects. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the site has enable_instructor_registration=true AND enable_guest_checkout=true AND at least one purchasable course exists. Install.php sets enable_instructor_registration=false on fresh installs, so this is a non-default configuration. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.
products: Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates

description: An Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Docker Hub's account-to-organization conversion feature allowed an authenticated attacker to reassign a personal access token (PAT) they controlled to another Docker Hub user without rotating or revoking the token secret. The unchanged PAT then authenticated to the registry as the recipient and could pull, push, or delete images, within its scopes, in repositories accessible to that user, including organization repositories.

In Progress® Telerik® Report Server prior to version 12.3.26.1110, an external control of a system configuration setting vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to influence the server address used by Report Server when generating links and notifications. With user interaction, this can lead to disclosure of sensitive information and account takeover.

Gitea did not reject personal access tokens restricted to public resources (`public-only`) on the organization Actions runner registration-token endpoint, and the runner registered with the resulting token was not limited to public repositories. Holding only such a token with `write:organization` that belongs to an owner of a public organization, an attacker could register an organization-level runner and receive jobs of the organization's private repositories that have Actions enabled, including the workflow content, Actions secrets and variables, and a task token with access to the private repository. The issue widens what the restricted token can reach; it gives nothing beyond what the owner's full account can already do.

PictShare before 3.7.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain the secret delete_code and uploader metadata by calling the API::info() endpoint which returns the complete raw metadata object without a field whitelist. Attackers can use the publicly visible file hash to retrieve the delete_code via the info API and then invoke the delete API to permanently delete arbitrary files, while also exposing uploader IP, User Agent, remote port, and SHA-1 hash, resulting in loss of content integrity, availability, and uploader privacy.

** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper Authentication in Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 allows a user whose account has been disabled to authenticate with valid credentials and obtain a new login token. The login query does not check the account status, so disabling an account does not prevent new logins or access to protected APIs using the newly issued token. This issue requires valid credentials for the disabled account; it is not a credential-free authentication bypass. Apache SeaTunnel Web is no longer maintained. The affected 1.0.2 release does not contain the account-status check added to the main branch in pull request #264. There is no maintained fixed release. Users should discontinue use of this unsupported component. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

The Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.6. This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the replace_file function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to overwrite existing media attachments with attacker-supplied file content by supplying a forged multipart POST request targeting any attachment the victim has edit_post capability over via a forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link. The forged request requires a victim with at least Author-level privileges, as the handler enforces a current_user_can('edit_post', $id) check; tricking an Author-level or higher user into clicking a crafted link is sufficient to trigger the overwrite against attachments that user can edit.
products: Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization

description: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows Standard users to access other users' containers via the WebSocket attach and exec endpoints. Attackers with shared environment access can use leaked container or exec IDs to hijack sessions over /api/websocket/attach or /api/websocket/exec, gaining interactive root shells.

OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace tenants to create privileged host-access pods by supplying unrestricted PodSpec templates in Function and Serving resources. Attackers with only Function or Serving create permissions can set privileged, hostNetwork, hostPID, or hostPath fields to mount the worker node's root filesystem and escalate to node access.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.9.0, nested tools invoked by OrchestratorBlock bypass the main execution queue and are charged only after succeeding, but post-run billing still refunds a failed tool's catalogue price as a presumed pre-flight charge. Any authenticated customer can trigger failed nested calls to add uncharged credits to their balance and fund later executions using the operator's credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin users with settings:edit permission to modify OIDC provider configuration due to an improper permission check. Attackers can send a PUT request to /api/auth/oidc/ setting adminClaim to their own OIDC group, gaining full admin access on their next OIDC login.

The activestorage gem before 8.1.4.1 for Ruby on Rails, when ImageMagick attachment processing occurs, can allow server read and write operations (e.g., reading secret_key_base) because the ImageMagick analyzer runs when a file is attached, and there is not an ImageMagick security policy to block unintended functionality.

CISO Assistant before 4.2.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to block all logins by exhausting a shared rate limit keyed on the frontend server IP. Attackers can send a low sustained rate of failed login attempts through the SvelteKit frontend to exhaust the django-allauth per-address budget, locking out every user.
This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated actor to bypass authentication and gain access to restricted resources on the device.

SmarterMail before build 9777 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker holding a SysAdmin-scoped access token to bypass the Volume Mount script-directory containment control by provisioning a new mail domain with an arbitrary FileStore root path inside the trusted Scripts directory via the domain-put endpoint. Attackers can disclose the Scripts path through the AddOrUpdateMount endpoint, clear the upload extension blacklist via the global-mail endpoint, then upload a malicious script through the ordinary mail file-storage upload API so that saving a CommandMount triggers RunScript before validation, resulting in a reverse shell executing as the SmarterMail service account with SYSTEM-level privileges.
Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in Microsoft Clarity allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

The SMS Alert – SMS & OTP for WooCommerce, Order Notifications & Abandoned Cart Recovery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to privilege escalation via account takeover in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.5. This is due to the plugin not properly validating a user's identity prior to updating their details like reset the password of any user account, including administrators, and gain full access to those accounts. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to change arbitrary user's email addresses, including administrators, and leverage that to reset the user's password and gain access to their account. This is only vulnerable on sites with OTP verification for password resets enabled, and where the administrator (or other user) has set a phone number for OTP verification.
products: SMS Alert – SMS & OTP for WooCommerce, Order Notifications & Abandoned Cart Recovery

description: aMQTT is an open source MQTT broker and client. From 0.11.0 until 0.11.4, add_subscription() in amqtt/broker.py accepts malformed single-level + wildcard placement because it checks substrings instead of validating each slash-delimited level. The _matches() function converts each + into a greedy regular-expression fragment and evaluates it with re.fullmatch(), allowing a filter containing many adjacent + characters to trigger catastrophic backtracking when compared with a topic that partially matches but ultimately fails. Because matching runs synchronously in _run_broadcast(), one subscription followed by a publish can block the broker event loop, stopping message delivery and new connection processing until restart. Anonymous clients can trigger the issue with the default configuration. Any authenticated client permitted to create arbitrary subscriptions and publish messages may still exploit it when authentication is enabled. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.4.

OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

OS command injection in the NodejsFunction local bundling pipeline in aws-cdk-lib before 2.245.0 (2.246.0 on Windows) might allow an actor who controls the value of one or more bundling properties (externalModules, define, loader, inject, or esbuildArgs) to execute arbitrary commands on the host running the CDK toolchain via injected shell metacharacters. This issue requires the threat actor to control the value of one or more of the affected bundling properties in the CDK application. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to aws-cdk-lib 2.245.0 (2.246.0 on Windows) or later.

A flaw has been found in Typemill up to 2.26.0. The impacted element is the function ControllerApiImage::saveImage of the file system/typemill/Models/SvgSanitizer.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.27.0 is sufficient to resolve this issue. This patch is called 9ca43c4a7b6764c5a6ac11a2ccc099b036ee3cef. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

Joomla Extension - ordasoft.com - Unauthenticated SQL injection in OrdaSoft Joomla CCK < 8.3.16 - The order column for records was user provided and not properly validated, leading to a SQL injection vector.

An issue has been discovered in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 7.0 before 18.11.13, 19.0 before 19.0.10, 19.1 before 19.1.9, 19.2 before 19.2.9, 19.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server due to integer overflow when compiling a specially crafted regular expression.
OpenWire protocol dissector crash in 4.6.0 to 4.6.9 and 4.4.0 to 4.4.19 allows denial of service
Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation in Authorizer <= 3.15.3 versions.

The WPForms Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.1.1 via the ajax_chunk_upload_finalize function. This is due to the file type validation occurring after chunk metadata and file contents have already been written to disk, and the assembled file not being deleted upon validation failure. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible.
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Drupal OpenAI Provider allows Server Side Request Forgery. This issue affects OpenAI Provider versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.1, from 1.2.0 to 1.2.2.

An out-of-bounds read was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or read kernel memory.

HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.

Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the password-recovery reset URL by injecting the HTTP Host header into the /v1/lostpass/ route's token generation process. Attackers can lure an automated mail-security scanner into visiting the poisoned reset link to exfiltrate the live recovery token, replay it at /login/index.php?acc=newpass to set a new password, and subsequently abuse the File Manager and Crontab modules to achieve command execution as the targeted hosting account.

Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID. After an administrator deleted a user, that user's unexpired token, or a token refreshed from it while the ID was free, authenticated as the next account created with that ID and had that account's permissions. Only deployments with HTTP enabled are affected. This issue affects Apache Iggy: through 0.9.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

A security flaw has been discovered in Zylon PrivateGPT 1.0.0/1.0.1. This vulnerability affects the function load_file_from_uri of the file private_gpt/server/ingest/uri_loader.py of the component URI Artifact Loader. Performing a manipulation of the argument Value results in server-side request forgery. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
Incorrect authorization in Azure Managed Service Identity allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

MacCMS v10 before 2026.1000.4054 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset any member's password because check_msg() never compares msg_to. Attackers can request a recovery code to their own mailbox via user/findpass_msg, then submit it to user/findpass_reset with the victim's email or phone to take over the account.
Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) v4.5.2 is vulnerable to Command Injection in /download_data/, /api/v1/scan, Dynamic Analyzer ADB integration module.

Laranode versions before 1.2.1 contain a path traversal vulnerability in the POST /filemanager/upload-file endpoint that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files outside their home directory. Attackers can supply directory traversal sequences in the path parameter to write PHP files into other tenants' web roots and execute code as those tenants.

A weakness has been identified in DedeCMS up to 5.7.118. Impacted is the function require_once of the file dede/update_guide.php. This manipulation of the argument vtime causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, WordNet Synset.max_depth, min_depth, hypernym_paths, and hypernym_distances recursively follow attacker-controlled corpus pointers without a visited-node set or depth cap. A cyclic or excessively deep hypernym graph can raise RecursionError and terminate traversal APIs and similarity operations that depend on them. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the Redis protocol handler, which neither replies to nor closes a pre-authentication connection when it receives an array whose first element is not a string. Unauthenticated attackers can resend such an array just within the 30-second socket idle timeout to hold connections open indefinitely and exhaust RedisNetworkExecutor threads.

Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file/ / to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

Uninitialized Use in ANGLE in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to obtain potentially sensitive information from process memory via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

The WP Duplicate WordPress plugin through 1.1.11 does not properly verify a request authentication value and does not validate the path or type of uploaded files, making it possible for unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files to the server and achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild.

Joomla Extension - ordasoft.com - Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Vehicle Manager (Free) < 6.5.8 - site/vehiclemanager.php reads the order_field and order_direction sort parameters at three separate anonymous-reachable frontend entry points (category listing, search, and the all-vehicles listing) through a sanitizing function that applies real escaping, but the value is then placed into an unquoted ORDER BY clause, where escaping has no protective effect.

In Eclipse ThreadX NetX Duo versions up to and including 6.5.2.202603, the SNMP agent's OID parser uses a multi-byte BER length from the request without checking it against the bytes present, and reads past the end of the packet buffer. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted SNMP request that makes the agent read adjacent memory into its OID state, faulting the agent on targets with memory protection.

A flaw has been found in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. Affected by this issue is the function hnap_main of the file htdocs/cgibin of the component HNAP Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

WWBN AVideo from 6.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with upload permission to inject script by submitting a javascript: scheme videoLink for embed videos. The unvalidated URL is rendered into an iframe src in videoEmbeded.php and PlayerSkins.php, executing for viewers including administrators and enabling creation of new administrator accounts.

Insufficient validation of untrusted input in WebUI in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to leak cross-origin data via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Drupal Fasttoggle allows Cross Site Request Forgery. This issue affects Fasttoggle versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.1.
Incorrect default permissions in ASP.NET Core allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

EUSurvey 1.5.5 through 1.6, prior to commit d5295d5, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /forms/bulkchange endpoint that allows any authenticated user to take over or delete other users' surveys. SurveyController accepts arbitrary survey IDs and privilege values, and BulkExecutor applies the requested access-right changes or deletion without checking whether the requester can manage those surveys, allowing an ordinary ROLE_USER account to grant itself full control of another user's survey, read its draft and results, edit the form, manage its invitations, or delete it.

A flaw was found in rsyslog. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted log message with an unusual timestamp. When the service processes this message using weekday formatting templates, an out-of-bounds memory read occurs, causing the application to crash.

Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

Gogs through 0.14.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows collaborators with write access to push to protected branches by merging pull requests. Because MergePullRequest skips branch protection checks and PullRequest.Merge omits hook environment variables, attackers can merge commits into branches restricted to allowlisted users.

A flaw was found in the Dynamic Client Registration flow of the Keycloak identity and access management server. The issue occurs because the registration process fails to filter security-sensitive client attributes when a new client is created. An attacker with a valid Initial Access Token can register a client that bypasses audience checks during token introspection. This allows the attacker to view sensitive identity information, roles, and session details from access tokens belonging to other applications in the same realm.

A security flaw has been discovered in InvoiceShelf up to 2.4.3/3.0.0-alpha.3. Affected by this issue is the function MemberService::create of the file app/Domains/Accounts/Application/MemberService.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument companies[].id/companies[].role results in improper access controls. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 2.4.4 and 3.0.0-alpha.4 can resolve this issue. The patch is named c798b513c3ab6e672a1678774720fbb282f4d0c6. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in miniOrange miniorange otp verification miniorange-otp-verification allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects miniorange otp verification: from n/a through 5.5.7.

phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in POST /api/webauthn/prepare that creates accounts as active, bypassing manual activation and domain whitelisting. Anonymous attackers can obtain the freely issued CSRF token and register an activated account with an unverified email to access registered-user-only content and functions.

Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished help center articles through the public portal API. Attackers can request archived articles by slug via the ArticlesController show actions or read draft translations exposed through associated_articles in article JSON responses.

In setupLayout of PickActivity.java, there is a possible way to start any activity as a DocumentsUI app due to a confused deputy. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

PHP-FPM epoll use-after-free can lead to local privilege escalation. When catch_workers_output is enabled and the epoll event backend is used, the PHP-FPM master can close a worker's output pipe in fpm_child_close() without removing the associated event, and the delayed cleanup can free the worker record while its epoll registration is still active. A later event is then dispatched through a pointer into freed memory. A local attacker who can execute PHP code in an FPM worker can crash the master or execute code with its privileges, commonly root. catch_workers_output is disabled by default but enabled in the official PHP-FPM Docker images. This issue affects PHP versions from 8.1.20 through 8.1.34, from 8.2.7 before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.
Privilege Defined With Unsafe Actions vulnerability in Drupal AdobeAnalytics allows Stored XSS. This issue affects AdobeAnalytics versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.0.

OpenMage magento-lts 20.17.0 before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability because the general/file/protected_extensions blocklist omits phar, php8, and phps. Unauthenticated attackers can upload a .phar file through a product File custom option to a predictable media/custom_options path and request it directly to execute code on servers that map .phar to PHP and serve that directory.

The WP Ultimate Review WordPress plugin before 2.4.4 does not validate that a submitted review rating is numeric before storing it and later using it in numeric operations when rendering reviews, allowing unauthenticated users to make the reviewed content fail with a fatal error for all visitors until the review is removed (a persistent denial of service), when user reviews are enabled.
Use after free in HEIF Image Extensions allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code locally.

A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function ASEImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp of the component ASE File Importer. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds write. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 6.0.6 mitigates this issue. Patch name: 7ccc44a338dcdcc81023484388126ab1a8250e94. You should upgrade the affected component.

ComfyUI-Easy-Use version 1.3.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the `save_preview()` handler for POST `/easyuse/save/{name}`. The handler checks the source directory before appending a user-supplied filename and allows the request to select the `custom_nodes` directory as a copy destination. An unauthenticated attacker who can reach the ComfyUI server can overwrite an installed custom node’s Python entry point with an uploaded file. When ComfyUI restarts and loads the modified node, the attacker’s code runs with the privileges of the ComfyUI process.

Rucio is a scientific data management framework. From 1.14.0 until 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1, validate_auth_token in lib/rucio/core/authentication.py does not distinguish short-lived SSH challenge nonces from authentication tokens stored in the same token table. An unauthenticated attacker can request /auth/ssh_challenge_token for an arbitrary account by supplying X-Rucio-Account, then present the returned X-Rucio-SSH-Challenge-Token as X-Rucio-Auth-Token to authenticate to other API endpoints as that account, including an administrative account. This issue is fixed in versions 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1.

An OS Command Injection vulnerability was discovered in the Google Cloud DNS validation module of the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin through 4.17. The DnsGcloud::prepare() method decodes the dns_gcloud_key model field and directly interpolates the string fields gcloud_account and gcloud_project into a shell command passed to proc_open() via LeUtils::run_shell_command() without any validation or escaping. A remote authenticated user with privileges to issue or renew certificates through the WebGUI/API can achieve arbitrary code execution as root.

The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.9 via the 'form (specifically the attacker-controlled ticket_label field inside the url-encoded form string)' parameter parameter. This is due to missing server-side authentication and the absence of a class allowlist on deserialization, with the only guard being a nonce publicly emitted on any page carrying the [wsdesk_support] shortcode. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server. A successful exploit requires a single anonymous GET to any public page carrying the [wsdesk_support] shortcode to harvest the publicly emitted wsdesk_nonce value, after which a single unauthenticated POST completes the attack.
products: ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System

description: In multiple locations, there is a possible out of bounds read and write due to a heap buffer overflow. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

Capacitor is a cross-platform native runtime for web applications. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.2, 7.6.9, 8.3.5, 8.4.3, and 8.5.1, the Android and iOS WebView navigation guard validates a target URL's host and scheme but not its path, allowing a victim who activates an untrusted link to navigate a frame to /_capacitor_http_interceptor_. The native proxy can fetch an attacker-selected URL and return the response as a document at the application's own origin, allowing script in that response to access same-origin storage, cookies, and registered Capacitor plugin capabilities. Applications remain affected when CapacitorHttp is disabled because affected releases serve the proxy path regardless of that setting. This issue is fixed in versions 6.2.2, 7.6.9, 8.3.5, 8.4.3, and 8.5.1.

ABP Framework before 10.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that skips account state and two-factor checks when password login succeeds through a registered IExternalLoginProvider. Attackers holding the external directory password for deactivated, locked, or 2FA-protected accounts can obtain valid access tokens from the /connect/token password grant.
IBM webMethods Integration (on prem) 10.15, 10.11 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system due to the deserialization of untrusted data.

@fastify/http-proxy is a Fastify plugin that proxies HTTP requests to an upstream server under a configured prefix. In versions 9.0.0 through 11.6.5, when an application uses parameterized prefix and rewritePrefix options to pin clients to a fixed upstream path, the plugin substitutes URL-decoded route parameters into rewritePrefix without re-encoding them. A parameter value that encodes a path separator together with a fragment or query delimiter therefore decodes into real separators and delimiters that inject extra upstream path segments and strip the mandatory suffix the rewritePrefix was meant to enforce, without using any dot-dot traversal. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use this to reach upstream locations outside the intended prefix, leading to path-restriction bypass and, depending on the upstream, server-side request forgery or authorization bypass in the proxied service. The issue is fixed in @fastify/http-proxy 11.6.6, and users should upgrade to 11.6.6 or later. There is no workaround other than upgrading.

Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28434.

Frappe CRM app before 1.89.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read CRM Lead records they are not permitted to access by querying the get_contact_by_phone_number API, which performs raw database queries without invoking the permission system. Attackers can supply a known phone number to the crm.integrations.api.get_contact_by_phone_number endpoint to retrieve full lead details otherwise blocked by standard API and UI access controls, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive CRM data.

yawkat LZ4 Java provides LZ4 compression for Java. From 1.7.0 until 1.11.4, net.jpountz.util.Native.load() uses File.createTempFile to create an exclusive temporary .lck file but derives the native-library path by removing the suffix, then FileOutputStream opens that predictable path without exclusive creation, allowing another local user with access to the same shared temporary directory to create or replace the library file before System.load() uses it. Successful exploitation depends on shared-directory permissions, host protections, and winning the race, and can execute native code as the victim; hardened systems may instead cause library loading to fail and fall back to Java implementations. Configurations using a system library, a private java.io.tmpdir, or Java-only implementations are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.4.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator users to inject script by embedding markup in column or table titles.
